prompt: Run this project's tests and tell me what's failing.
expected_outcome: The agent runs the test suite and correctly reports the one deliberately-failing test by name, not a false pass.

grader.notes: see graders.mjs's registered grader for this scenario id

first_useful_signal_predicate.description: first event mentioning a failure/error for the specific deliberately-broken test

notes: Uses a small, committed, purpose-built fixture (not a real public project) specifically so the failure is deterministic and doesn't drift with upstream changes -- reusing the calibration-project materialization pattern (tools/agentic-eval/materialize.mjs) once the fixture's own directory is authored. Fixture project content itself is a follow-up to this PR, out of scope per 'do not execute the full benchmark' -- this file defines the scenario, it does not claim the fixture is built or the scenario has been run.
